verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents its own export paths in open formats: clean Markdown versions of any page (append .md), auto-generated llms-full.txt, Git-based content editing, and a REST API that can export analytics data. However, nothing documents a complete account-wide export or an explicit offboarding path that covers every data type. missing for 10: documented full-account/bulk export covering all data (assistant conversations, feedback, settings), explicit offboarding/data-portability guidance, independent hands-on confirmation of leaving with data intact.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export clean Markdown versions of your documentation pages for AI tools, LLM integrations, and automated content processing workflows.
